# FastAPI CRUD Pattern

Use this pattern when adding a simple JSON-storage CRUD feature.

Example feature name: books

## Files to create

schemas/books.py
routers/books.py

## Files to edit

main.py

## Step 1 - Schema

Create schemas/books.py.

Rules:
- Use Pydantic BaseModel.
- Use a Create schema for request bodies.
- Use a response schema for returned data.
- Response schema should include id.
- Add created_at and updated_at when useful.

Example structure:

BookCreate:
- title: string
- author: string

Book:
- id: string
- title: string
- author: string
- created_at: string optional
- updated_at: string optional

## Step 2 - Router

Create routers/books.py.

Rules:
- Define router = APIRouter(prefix="/books", tags=["books"]).
- Use load_db(), save_db(), generate_id() from core.storage.
- Use now_iso() and not_found() from core.utils when useful.
- Use response_model where practical.

Required endpoints:
- GET /
- POST /
- GET /{book_id}
- PUT /{book_id}
- DELETE /{book_id}

## Step 3 - Register router

Edit main.py.

Add import:

from routers import books

Add router registration:

app.include_router(books.router)

## Step 4 - Validate

Run:

python -c "from main import app; print(app.title)"
python -c "from main import app; print([route.path for route in app.routes])"

Expected:
- app imports successfully
- new route paths appear
- no .env file is tracked
- no __pycache__ files are tracked
